# Azure Emulator Family

> The certified set: a bill of materials pinning every emulator, a docker compose that stands them up together, and a chain test that proves the combination rather than the parts.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://calvinchengx.github.io/azure-emulators/docs/01-quickstart/): The whole family, one command. Nothing to install but Docker.
- [The family](https://calvinchengx.github.io/azure-emulators/docs/02-the-family/): Six emulators, each its own repo, its own release cadence, its own GHCR image. This repo composes them and proves they still trust each other.
- [Release coordination](https://calvinchengx.github.io/azure-emulators/docs/03-release-coordination/): Six independently released products that must work together. This is how the family stays consistent without freezing anyone's cadence.
- [The chain test](https://calvinchengx.github.io/azure-emulators/docs/04-chain-test/): The one check no single emulator's repo can make.
